name: ILLUSTRATIVE Problem Board
heading: ILLUSTRATIVE Local Problem Board
sub: Fictional local engineering and design challenges. In the planned Venture Hub, founders and student apprentices will collaborate on tangible district problems.

problems.title: Stream Silt & Hydel Intake Telemetry
problems.description: Continuous monitoring of water turbidity and intake silt levels in mountain stream micro-turbines.
problems.apprenticeRole: Students test analog-to-digital sensor calibration and record baseline voltage readings.
problems.output: Open hardware sensor probe with local serial logging.

problems.title: Cold-Storage Thermal Logging
problems.description: Battery-backed temperature loggers for high-altitude apple and medicinal herb storage.
problems.apprenticeRole: Students write data verification tests to detect sensor disconnects or temperature anomalies.
problems.output: Low-power microcontroller unit with offline flash memory.

problems.title: Traditional Woodcraft Joinery Documentation
problems.description: Digital measurement and shear stress modeling of regional earthquake-resistant timber joints.
problems.apprenticeRole: Students assist in spatial measurements and draft geometric diagrams of wood interlocks.
problems.output: Vector library of traditional seismic joinery patterns.

problems.title: Mountain Road Alert Network
problems.description: Short-message packet relays for high-pass transit alerts when mobile towers lose connectivity.
problems.apprenticeRole: Students conduct range tests and check signal reception across valley observation points.
